items.question: Who is AD Durr?
items.answer: Asia "AD" Durr is an American professional basketball player who currently plays for the Charlotte Crown of the UpShot League.

items.question: What team does AD Durr play for?
items.answer: Her most recent WNBA team on record is the New York Liberty. She wears No. 25. Her listed position is Guard.
